chapters.title: Chapter 515: Demon Of Eclipse
paragraphs: "I don’t know how to say it ...but this is an instinctive feeling, I have no idea what this Witness is, but I’m sure if we want to get the Sphere, we have to separate those damn veins from it," Kain said seriously.
Lian looked at him, naturally, he had no reason to doubt his friend’s instinct, especially since this instinctive feeling he had might come from the Tear Of Witness inside his body.
"And I guess you’re the only one who can help me," he added.
"No problem, I’ve got you covered," the young Vorhelm simply added, besides all of this, he felt that those black veins would be very useful to him.
"What you need to do is simple, just when they are separated from the Sphere, completely destroy them with lightning or ice."
Kain stood on the main platform, the circular grooves under his feet started to glow.
When he placed both palms on the white surface in front of him, the Light inside his body entered the structure, he had no idea what he was doing, every movement he made was completely instinctive.
At that moment, the Sphere of Witness changed, its pure white color became golden for a moment and the twelve rings stopped moving at the same time.
Then they started rotating in the opposite direction, the black veins on the Sphere twisted and some of them started rising from their places.
The first drop separated from the surface of the Sphere, a completely black liquid that remained floating in the air.
Lian reached his hand forward, but no ice or lightning appeared on his hand, even though Kain had told him to destroy this thing, his instinct was telling him something else.
His instincts were screaming that this thick black liquid, whatever it was, would give him an unbelievable benefit.
The drop was suddenly pulled toward him and entered his body.
For a moment, he felt nothing special, as if nothing had happened, but suddenly ...his eyes widened.
He felt something moving through his veins and all the energy channels in his body, and wherever it went, it was eating away at the energy structure around it.
He felt all the Mana inside his body being destroyed and worn away.
What the fucking hell was happening?
He had no doubt that if his body had the structure of a normal human, maybe even that tiny amount would have been enough to destroy all his Mana channels from the inside.
The black liquid moved toward a special space inside his body, the same special space that had appeared after his first evolution, the same place where a Core was supposed to exist.
[Incompatible energy has entered.]
[Compression process has started.]
Lian slowly let out a breath.
Kain, who was still keeping both hands on the platform, asked without turning around.
"What did you do? I told you to destroy those black veins! Why did you absorb it? Are you crazy? That thing was even able to disable something that belonged to a god-like being!"
He wanted to stop what he was doing, because then the black veins would stop separating from the Sphere, but he could not watch his best friend die!
Lian also seemed to be completely in a trance and gave no answer.
"What...? Fuck fuck fuck!" Kain suddenly realized that no matter what he did, he could not stop the Light!
Whatever he did, the Light coming from his body would not stop!
"What is happening? Fuck, it’s stuck! If you don’t stop, Lian will die! ...Please stop!"
But it was as if his body no longer listened to him, it was only following the instinct it was supposed to follow.
At that moment, the second vein separated from the Sphere, then the third one, and this time the flow did not stop.
At the same time, outside the Sanctuary, the battle was still continuing.
The blade of one of the Region Six soldiers came down on the glowing shield of a Region Three soldier, Mana sparks exploded between them and both of them were pushed back.
Neither of them noticed the black stain that had started moving on the wall a few meters away from them.
A dry and hard surface that had looked like part of the stone for centuries...slowly became soft and a black drop fell down.
In another street, the black stain covering the body of one of the dried pilgrims flowed down from his shoulder and entered the grooves on the street.

The same thing happened in thousands of places across the city, wherever that black liquid existed, it was set in motion by the remains of energy that had been trapped inside that material for centuries.
Those veins entered the old channels of the city and all followed the same path, all of them moved in the same direction.
The Sanctuary.
The forces of Region Three and Region Six were still fighting, for now, no one had noticed that the city under their feet was changing.
Inside the Sanctuary, Lian was no longer absorbing only one or two drops.
The black liquid separated from the Sphere, entered the rings around it, and then was pulled toward him through the structure of the ritual.
That special empty space inside his body, which was meant for the formation of a Core, was slowly being filled.
But what was gathering there was not a Core yet, it was a shapeless black mass.
He tried to keep his breathing steady, he had understood what was happening to his body, a Core was forming inside him.
A fucking monster Core was forming inside his body.
But how? After his first evolution, he had wondered how he could obtain a Core, but he had no answer, and now this was suddenly happening so quickly?
And what exactly was this black liquid that could turn into a Core inside his body?
But before he needed to think about it too much, the world in front of him shattered and for a moment, the huge space of the Sanctuary disappeared.
At first, the only thing he could see was darkness ...then it turned into the sky.
Lian felt that he was at an impossible height, but he was not flying, he could not feel any wings and there was no force holding him in the air.
It took a few seconds for him to understand what was happening, and then after looking around, he realized that he was really floating in the sky.
The sea was still below, and hundreds of ships were moving across it, and near the docks, there were places filled with people.
Along with white towers and mirrors that reflected the light of the sky.
There was no doubt, he was above Silent Light.
Was he seeing a memory ...? But whose memories exactly?
And the feeling that came with the memory into Lian’s mind was nothing like the view of an attacker looking at a large city.
He only felt indifference from this memory, as if the people below were not even enemies, but only small and worthless points.
Things that moved, things that had not been extinguished yet and needed to be destroyed ...that was all.
Then he finally heard a voice, a calm voice, but when that creature spoke, the clouds in the sky shook.
The surface of the sea formed waves.
And the towers of the city cracked from the pressure for a moment.
"I am the living eclipse, the shadow that existed before the first flame and will remain after the last Light."
"I am the hunger between the beginning and the end, the decay hidden behind every creation and the silence that remains after worlds collapse."
It paused for a moment.
It was as if the creature had only decided to make the creatures below aware of something that it itself considered an obvious truth.
"Your names, your gods, your cities, and the skies you consider sacred...to me, they are only things that I have not had the chance to extinguish yet."
" I Am The Demon Of Eclipse!"
The image shattered.
Lian was inside the Sanctuary again, but only for a fraction of a second, and when more black liquid entered his body, the next memory appeared.
The sky was full of Light, thousands of attacks were happening, golden spears, arrows made of Light, and huge arrays that covered the entire sky.
Warriors were flying high in the sky, priests were standing on the towers.
If such a level of power was released on one of the countries of Earth, perhaps nothing would remain.
But the Demon Of Eclipse did not even defend itself.
Lian understood its feelings, there was no fear inside it, there was not even caution or worry, it truly saw this entire army of several hundred thousand people from the city as worthless points.
The creature only moved forward.
Hundreds of attacks hit its body at the same time.
BOOOOOOM!
Light covered everything for a few moments, the clouds broke apart from the explosion and the sea below was pushed to both sides by the pressure.
But when the Light faded, the Demon Of Eclipse was still moving, there was no serious wound on its body, and its speed had not even decreased.
It slowly raised its hand, a simple movement that was almost without interest ...then brought it down.
That single movement was enough to make all the buildings in the city separate from their foundations at the same time, not only the buildings, even all living creatures were lifted from the ground.
And suddenly everything fell back to the ground ...
But that same movement turned the holy city into an abandoned ruin with hundreds of thousands of dead.
From that single movement alone, Lian understood something that no number could explain to him, for the people of the city, this battle was the end of their world.
For the Demon Of Eclipse? It had not even reached the point where it could be called a battle.

"So this is a Demon ...?" He had always heard that Demons should never be compared with any other monster, that even if a million-person army of Awakened could hunt one of them, it would itself be a kind of honor.
And now he understood why, the power of a Demon was not even possible to imagine.
Just one movement of its hand was equal to the death of hundreds of thousands of people and the complete destruction of a holy city.
The image shattered again.
The black mass inside the Core space became larger, Lian clenched his teeth.
"Lian? Please answer, damn it! At least tell me you’re okay!" Kain could hear his voice from a distance.
But there was no answer, because the third memory had appeared.
Thousands of people, this time standing behind a huge array, with seven layers of Light shields placed over each other.
Each layer was connected to several towers, and thousands of priests and warriors were supplying it with energy.

Even from the memory, Lian could understand how difficult it would be to break such a defense with raw power, besides that, he understood that these were reinforcements that had been sent to save the city.
They could be considered some of the strongest military units of the Light Religion.
In the past, before its world fell, Silent Light had been at the center of a great civilization, there had been thousands of cities and villages around it.
And each of them had smaller and local sanctuaries, the military units of the Light Religion were spread among all the cities so they could defend them in case monsters attacked.
But when the holy city was attacked, all the military units received a call to return.
And this was one of the elite units that created a huge array to fight against this Demon.
The Demon Of Eclipse stopped, slowly looked at them, and at that moment, a part of the darkness on its body separated.
It was so small that compared to a finger, it looked almost worthless, the darkness reached the shield and then a black line formed inside the first layer.
Then a second one and a third one, and the Light around them started shaking, and the layers went out one after another.
The darkness moved inside the structure.
The priests tried to put in more energy, but it was useless, the more Mana they sent, the more food that darkness had to consume.
In less than a few seconds, the array that thousands of people were maintaining died without a huge explosion, without breaking the wall and without a direct attack...it simply died.
Its Light went out and its structure fell apart, and nothing remained.

Lian understood the nature of that energy, that thing was the Essence of the Demon Of Eclipse, its power was not in a bigger attack, the Essence of the Eclipse wore down the energy structure from the inside.
Unfortunately, these people had never faced a Demon before that day, they did not know what they were facing.
Every plan and weapon was meaningless against that monster.
The image shattered and the third memory also ended.
[Source of energy identified.]
[Remaining Essence of a Demon-ranked monster identified.]
[Source Name: Demon Of Eclipse.]
He looked at the Core, it was slowly becoming complete, and at that moment, the next memory appeared.
He saw the Sphere of Witness, the Sphere of Witness was floating above the shrine, but at that time ...it was not small and damaged.

Just one movement of its hand was equal to the death of hundreds of thousands of people and the complete destruction of a holy city.
The image shattered again.
The black mass inside the Core space became larger, Lian clenched his teeth.
"Lian?
Please answer, damn it!
At least tell me you’re okay!" Kain could hear his voice from a distance.
But there was no answer, because the third memory had appeared.
Thousands of people, this time standing behind a huge array, with seven layers of Light shields placed over each other.
Each layer was connected to several towers, and thousands of priests and warriors were supplying it with energy.

Even from the memory, Lian could understand how difficult it would be to break such a defense with raw power, besides that, he understood that these were reinforcements that had been sent to save the city.
They could be considered some of the strongest military units of the Light Religion.
In the past, before its world fell, Silent Light had been at the center of a great civilization, there had been thousands of cities and villages around it.
And each of them had smaller and local sanctuaries, the military units of the Light Religion were spread among all the cities so they could defend them in case monsters attacked.
But when the holy city was attacked, all the military units received a call to return.
And this was one of the elite units that created a huge array to fight against this Demon.
The Demon Of Eclipse stopped, slowly looked at them, and at that moment, a part of the darkness on its body separated.
It was so small that compared to a finger, it looked almost worthless, the darkness reached the shield and then a black line formed inside the first layer.
Then a second one and a third one, and the Light around them started shaking, and the layers went out one after another.
The darkness moved inside the structure.
The priests tried to put in more energy, but it was useless, the more Mana they sent, the more food that darkness had to consume.
In less than a few seconds, the array that thousands of people were maintaining died without a huge explosion, without breaking the wall and without a direct attack...it simply died.
Its Light went out and its structure fell apart, and nothing remained.

Lian understood the nature of that energy, that thing was the Essence of the Demon Of Eclipse, its power was not in a bigger attack, the Essence of the Eclipse wore down the energy structure from the inside.
Unfortunately, these people had never faced a Demon before that day, they did not know what they were facing.
Every plan and weapon was meaningless against that monster.
The image shattered and the third memory also ended.
[Source of energy identified.]
[Remaining Essence of a Demon-ranked monster identified.]
[Source Name: Demon Of Eclipse.]
He looked at the Core, it was slowly becoming complete, and at that moment, the next memory appeared.
He saw the Sphere of Witness, the Sphere of Witness was floating above the shrine, but at that time ...it was not small and damaged.

chapters.title: Chapter 516: Forming The First Core
paragraphs: Lian looked at the Sphere of Witness, so they had decided to use their biggest and only remaining trump card?
But this was not bad either, at least this way he could see what abilities that Sphere had.
An old man in a white robe raised both hands and his voice was lost among the bells, but the memory kept it clear.
"Activate White Noon!"
Light came and for a moment the very concept of shadow was removed from the city, there was no front or back, no darkness remained between the buildings and the entire world became white.
The young Vorhelm could not see anything inside the memory, he could only feel the pressure.
A power so great that the city itself started to melt in response, this was a counterattack that could even end with the destruction of the city itself
It was as if the followers of Light had become so crazy to kill this demon that they were willing to do anything.
The sea below the city started boiling within a few seconds and huge amounts of steam rose into the sky, hundreds of people who did not have time to leave disappeared in that same Light.
The towers bent from the heat, parts of the ground turned into a shiny material and, White Noon, which came from the Sphere of Witness, was destroying the city itself.
And all of this was for one goal, the Demon Of Eclipse.
For a few moments, nothing could be seen of the creature, everything was completely white, even the remaining followers of Light thought they had succeeded.
But then a shadow moved inside that Light, it slowly took one step and the Demon Of Eclipse came out of White Noon.
Part of the outer layer of its Essence had burned, black drops were separating from its body, but there was no deep wound and no missing body part could be seen.
But its attention had been caught, the creature looked at the collapsing city and then at the Sphere of Witness.
Its calm voice once again fell over the city.
"So this was all the Light you gathered to fight me?"
Down below, houses were burning, the sea no longer existed, humans were dying in the Light they themselves had released.
The Demon Of Eclipse stayed silent for a few moments.
"It was beautiful...for something that is going to die." Then it looked at the sky with a mocking look, as if it was looking at something beyond that sky.
Lian only stayed silent, he had felt the power of the Sphere of Witness and the thing that White Noon came from.

That thing could turn him into ashes in an instant, he doubted that even an Overlord would have a chance against it and this showed that the Light Religion, before their world became a ruin, had been a powerful civilization.
But all of this, in the eyes of the Demon Of Eclipse, was no different from a joke.
The memory did not end and this time it continued, the whiteness slowly left the city.
And what remained no longer looked like the same city from a few minutes ago.
The sea had turned into steam and a large part of its bottom had melted.
The buildings were even more abandoned than before, the bodies of humans had remained still inside the melted material.
The towers were falling one after another, but above all that destruction, the Demon Of Eclipse was still standing.
The creature looked at the city, almost without any emotion, as if something under its feet was so unimportant that even its destruction was not worth feeling anything about.
Its gaze stopped on the shrine, more exactly, on the Sphere of Witness.
"If your Divine is still watching you... tell him that Eclipse extinguished his Light."
And then it turned around, that was all, the demon itself decided to leave.
The city of Silent Light had used everything it had against it.
And the result? The creature had only lost interest.
For a moment, Lian did not even know which part of this terrifying truth was worse.
But right before the end of the memory, he saw something else.
Some of the black Essence that White Noon had separated from the surface of the Demon Of Eclipse’s body was pulled toward the Sphere of Witness.
The rings trapped it inside themselves, but not all of the Essence was captured, part of it fell down and went directly into the remains of the sea that had evaporated.
He saw himself inside the shrine again, this time for real, his breathing was heavier and cold sweat covered his forehead.
But the main pain was almost over, the formation of the Core was almost complete and finally a black Sphere took shape..
Click.
[Compression process completed.]
[First Monster Core has been formed.]
[Eclipse Core.]
[Monster Cores: 1.]
Lian did nothing for a few seconds, he only felt it, the small black Core had slowly settled into place.
This was the first time that the empty space actually had something inside it, but along with the satisfaction of forming his first Core, he also felt something else.
There was still a lot of empty space.
He already knew that monsters could have a considerable number of Cores and with every evolution, the number of their Cores increased.
But knowing it as a rule was different from experiencing it directly.
He also realized that he could have many Cores, but there was also a difference, his Cores were special, they were not like the Cores of other monsters.
[Eclipse Core.]
[Origin: Scattered Essence of a Demon-ranked being.]
[Special Energy Type: Eclipse Essence.]
[Innate Effect: Energy and Element Erosion.]
[Eclipse Energy can erode structures formed from Mana, Elements, and other forms of energy at the point of contact.]
Lian read the next lines.
[The Core can store a limited amount of Eclipse Energy, with evolution, the amount will increase.]
For a moment, he closed his fingers and called a very small amount of the Core’s energy.
A black line appeared on the tip of his finger and at the same time, he created a small layer with Mana.
When it touched the very small layer of Mana that he had created himself, the structure became dark at the point of contact, then it started collapsing.
The same thing he had seen in the memory, the death of the structure.
The young Vorhelm cut off the black line and a very faint smile appeared on his face, this energy was not going to only make his attacks bigger, its value was much greater than that.
But a question came to him, did this mean he could obtain a Core based on other demons?
At the same time, the last black vein separated from the surface of the Sphere of Witness.
Kain had thrown almost all of his body weight onto the platform, the color of his face had become a little pale, the amount of Mana he had used to keep the structure stable was not small.
His only happiness was that he saw Lian was safe and he was able to let out a sigh of relief.
But when the last black line came out, the Sphere changed and became completely white.
Pure Light flowed across its entire surface and the twelve rings around it stopped ...then slowly moved away from each other.
The Sphere started becoming smaller, at first so slowly that it was hard to notice, and then it became faster.
Several hundred meters.
One hundred meters.
Fifty.
Twenty.
The Light around it was also pulled toward the center along with it, the terraces of the shrine became a little darker for the first time.
Until finally, a white Sphere about thirty centimeters in size remained floating in the air in front of Kain.
Its Light was no longer blinding but warm and calm, but even at that size, its presence felt much heavier than an ordinary treasure.
Information appeared in front of Kain.
[Sphere of Witness]
[Rank: Ancient.]
[Warning, only the treasure itself can choose its owner.]
[Signature of the Tear of Witness identified.]
[Child of Light identified.]
[Establish bond?]
Kain stayed silent for longer than Lian expected, his gaze moved between the words and the Sphere.
This time he did not joke, perhaps even he understood how unusual the thing in front of him was.
"If I reject it now, I’ll probably never forgive myself for the rest of my life." He then said quietly.
But on the other hand, he did not know what responsibility he would have if he accepted it, or what things he would have to face in the future.
Lian understood his worries, but said nothing, this was completely his own decision.
Kain smiled.
"At least I don’t mind challenges and trouble."
[Yes.]
The Light of the Sphere became stronger for a moment, a thin strand of it entered his chest, and his body trembled slightly.
A few seconds later, the Sphere itself became smaller and turned into a point of Light that entered his body.
[Bond completed.]
[The Sphere of Witness can be stored in the soul and summoned when needed.]

chapters.title: Chapter 517: Leviathan Of Eclipse
paragraphs: Kain carefully looked at the details of the Ancient-ranked treasure he had obtained, this was an Ancient-ranked treasure!
He had never thought that one day he would have the chance to even touch something like this, and now? This treasure completely belonged to him.
And the more he read its explanations, the bigger his smile became.
"Were all the difficulties worth it or not?" Lian looked at him and asked.

"Of course! This thing is both an offensive and defensive artifact, and it perfectly matches my path of Light, I can’t even describe how valuable it is and I am truly grateful to you, without your help I couldn’t have obtained it," Kain said from the bottom of his heart.
Obtaining the Witness Sphere without the help of his best friend was completely impossible for him, it could even be said that Lian had carried most of the difficulties himself.
And this made him feel bad, Lian had gone through all the difficulties, but in the end, the treasure had gone to him.
"You’re welcome and what’s with that look?"
"You did all the work and in the end this treasure came to me."
"Don’t worry, it’s not like this trip was completely worthless for me," the young Vorhelm smiled, he had obtained his first Core.
And besides that, he had also understood to some extent how he could obtain more Cores, if his guess was correct, to form more Cores he needed to find the Essences of other demons.
And the Essences of demons could help him form more Cores, although it was not going to be easy.
And facing demons was the hardest part, he had no chance against a demon, in fact, even an Overlord might have no chance alone.
Until he reached at least the third evolution, it was unlikely that he would gain the power to directly face a demon.
"Besides, I found out how this city was destroyed," he then added.
"Really? How?" Kain asked with extreme curiosity, ever since he had read the Sphere’s information, he had been shocked about how a city with such a treasure had been able to fall.
"A demon attacked this city, the Demon Of Eclipse."
"A...demon?" The Child of Light’s eyes widened, he knew about demons, monsters that even Overlords feared.
Creatures that were so powerful that they could destroy continents.
Such a creature had attacked this city...?
"The people of this city tried to fight it using the Witness Sphere, but you can see the result, they didn’t even come close to defeating it."
Kain became silent, a long silence... and after that he let out a sigh, only a few minutes ago he had been excited about the Ancient treasure he had obtained.
But now he understood that there was a level of power against which even such a treasure was worthless...
Could he also reach that level one day?

But unlike him, Lian was calm, he was shocked by the power of a demon, but this only made him more determined to work hard and become stronger, he also wanted to become that powerful one day, even stronger!
Besides, a demon was definitely powerful, but he knew of an even more powerful being... his own father.
At that moment, outside the shrine, something changed.
The battle between Region Three and Region Six had still not ended.
But the black material that had disappeared from different parts of the city was no longer seen anywhere.
The dried humans who had turned into statues fell apart and turned into ashes.
Even the surface of the black area below the city had changed, gray cracks had appeared on it.
A Region Six soldier who was hiding behind a broken wall suddenly felt the ground shake.
Boom!
The man raised his head for a moment and at that moment the second shake came.
Boom!
This time more people noticed it.
"Wait..." One of the Region Three priests lowered his hand, he did not know why but he suddenly had a very bad feeling.
A sound came from the black area.
Krrrrrrrrrk...
Everyone turned their heads in that direction.
One of the ships that had been stuck there for several hundred years...had moved...?
But not because of the wind, and at that moment its rotten body slowly rose.
The wooden parts of the ship started breaking under the pressure of something lifting it from below.
"What is under there...?" one of the Region Six soldiers said in a very quiet voice.
The ship rose higher and then...KRRRRRRRRRK!
Its huge body broke in the middle and the two halves of the ship fell to both sides, and the black surface below it split open from inside.
Something came out.
At first, only a huge black blade that was taller than a several-story building could be seen, then a second blade appeared and suddenly more of the surface broke and...the creature’s head appeared.
A Region Three priest unconsciously took one step back.
The monster’s body continued rising.
Ten meters.
Twenty.
Thirty.
When its main body came out of the black area, even the battle between the two regions completely stopped for a few seconds.
The creature was at least sixty meters long.
Its body was long, something between a huge sea creature and a reptile that should never have lived in water.
Black and semi-transparent plates covered its entire back.
In some places, rusty chains had been fused into the armor of its body.
Part of an old ship’s body was attached to its side and even pieces of stone pillars were sticking out from between its black plates.
Six long limbs came out from under its body, they looked more like fins than legs.
Bent joints with hook-like claws that created cracks several dozen meters long whenever they touched the black surface.
But its head was worse than everything else, it had no eyes and instead, twelve small white holes were placed around its skull.
They lit up one after another.
One.
Two.
Three.
Until twelve.

Then its mouth opened, but not from the two sides of its face, instead, a crack formed from under its jaw to the center of its chest...the two front halves of its body moved apart and several rows of black and transparent teeth were revealed deep inside.
At the end of the creature’s throat, a faint white Light was shining, Lights that it had swallowed over the centuries.
[Leviathan Of Eclipse ]
[Rank: Fallen.]
[Level: 50.]
The face of one of the Region Three priests became pale.
"This monster...has descended from Hell!"
The commander of the Region Six unit, who until moments ago had been shouting orders to attack, slowly swallowed.
Neither of them looked at the human enemy in front of them anymore.
The Leviathan turned its head, the twelve white holes on its face turned toward the city and then one of its huge limbs rose.
"Fall back!" the Region Three commander suddenly shouted.
KAAAAAAABOOOOOOM!
The creature’s limb landed on the docks, the stone that had survived for centuries collapsed in an instant and dozens of meters of the docks disappeared.
A wave of stone, dust and black material was thrown into the air.
Several soldiers who did not have time to escape were thrown around like dolls.
Region Three and Region Six understood one thing completely, their main enemy was no longer each other, now it was this monster!
Inside the shrine...BOOOOOM!
The entire huge space shook and Kain immediately raised his head.
"What was that?"
"I have no idea, but it doesn’t seem like something good," Lian looked at him and answered calmly.

The commander of the Region Six unit, who until moments ago had been shouting orders to attack, slowly swallowed.
Neither of them looked at the human enemy in front of them anymore.
The Leviathan turned its head, the twelve white holes on its face turned toward the city and then one of its huge limbs rose.
"Fall back!" the Region Three commander suddenly shouted.
KAAAAAAABOOOOOOM!
The creature’s limb landed on the docks, the stone that had survived for centuries collapsed in an instant and dozens of meters of the docks disappeared.
A wave of stone, dust and black material was thrown into the air.
Several soldiers who did not have time to escape were thrown around like dolls.
Region Three and Region Six understood one thing completely, their main enemy was no longer each other, now it was this monster!
Inside the shrine...BOOOOOM!
The entire huge space shook and Kain immediately raised his head.
"What was that?"
"I have no idea, but it doesn’t seem like something good," Lian looked at him and answered calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 518: Leviathan Of Eclipse II
paragraphs: The roar from the other side of the gate echoed through the shrine again.
Lian and Kain both moved toward the shrine’s gate, and fortunately, there was no need to activate any special mechanism, the gate simply started opening after sensing their presence.
A thin line of light formed between the two sides of the gate and slowly became wider, but instead of moving, the young Vorhelm immediately opened his Status Panel.
The Stats points he had saved from the final hunt of the Wolfgrave were still untouched.
4,703 points.
He had not even looked at them at the time, and even now, his stats were already so high for his Level that they seemed unreal.
But his instincts told him that whatever was waiting for them outside was not something he could take lightly.
Now was not the time to save them.
[Stats points: 4,703.]
Lian divided them without hesitation.
[Resistance: 2,000 → 2,700.]
[Total Stats: 16,356.]
The change was not gentle.
The muscles under his skin tightened for a moment, his bones endured heavy pressure, and the amount of Mana moving through his paths suddenly increased.
The gate opened.
The smell of blood and burned stone reached them before the view did.
When he stepped out of the shrine, the first thing he saw was not the city, but that creature.
The Leviathan Of Eclipse was now almost completely out of the black area.

The lower part of its huge body was still among the remains of the broken docks, but three of its hook-like limbs had sunk into the streets near the shore, and every time it shifted its weight, the centuries-old stone pavement under its claws broke like pottery.
The distance between them and the creature was about four hundred meters, but even from the top of the huge shrine’s stairs, it looked enormous.
[Leviathan Of Eclipse.]
[Rank: Fallen.]
[Level: 50.]
Fallen.
Level 50.
If we do not count the Unborn Saint, it could be said that this was the strongest monster either of them had ever directly faced in their lives.
And the creature moving through the lower part of the city looked nothing like the ordinary Fallen they had seen until now.
Centuries of feeding on the remaining energy of the Eclipse Demon and the Light power that still leaked from the city had turned its body into something between two opposite sources.
And more importantly, it was Level 50, its stats were at least above 25,000.
Twelve white holes on the head of the Leviathan lit up one after another.
And at that exact moment, Predator’s Instincts screamed inside Lian’s mind.
"Down!"
He and Kain moved almost at the same time.
In the lower part of the city, the Leviathan opened its vertical mouth, the opening spread from under its jaw to the center of its chest, and white light gathered inside its throat.
But it was not pure white, black lines moved inside the light.
"Defensive array! Right now!" a priest from the Third Region shouted.
The four remaining priests in the main street raised their hands.
The first golden shield formed, then a second behind it, and then a third.

The forces of the Sixth Region also moved back behind the same line without caring about their enemy from a few minutes ago, and they even added their own power to be safe, adding several layers formed from dark power.
The Leviathan lowered its head.
[Maw of Blighted Radiance.]
The light was released, but it was not a beam, it was a flood, and the white street disappeared for a moment.
The first shield did not even last a second.
CRACK!
The second layer bent, the third resisted for a moment, and then black lines spread across its surface.
From a distance, Lian saw that the shield was not actually breaking, but its structure was being shut down, exactly like the power of that Eclipse Demon in the memories.
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!
The Blighted Radiance passed through the defenses, and the buildings on both sides of the street disappeared inside the white-black light.
The wave of heat and pressure even reached the shrine’s stairs and threw Kain’s robe backward.
When the light disappeared, that street no longer existed.
A black trench several dozen meters wide had been created through the city.
Those who had been directly in the path of the attack did not even leave a corpse behind.
Several people near the edge of the impact area were lying on the ground, their bodies burned and covered with black lines.
Kain stayed silent for several seconds.
"How the fucking hell is that a Fallen? It looks more like an Unholy!"
Lian said nothing, he had faced an even stronger monster before, so he was not easily surprised, but he was thinking about how they should deal with this thing.
At the same time, the Leviathan had raised its head, and the twelve white holes turned directly toward the shrine.
Or more exactly... toward him, as if the creature had sensed something inside him, something it wanted for itself.
Lian did not need to guess, this monster definitely wanted the remaining power of the Eclipse Demon for itself.
He did not hesitate and activated his armor.
[World-Devourer Bastion.]
"The fact that you put on your armor right from the start gives me the feeling that even you don’t know how we should deal with this monster." Kain gave a bitter smile.
"You’ve got the wrong idea, I put it on because I want to defeat it faster." The young Vorhelm said simply.
"I don’t know if I should say you’re confident or just arrogant... Lian, how are you going to defeat that thing?" The Child Of Light pointed toward the huge monster.
And at the same moment, one of the Leviathan’s six limbs rose from the street.
The creature was still hundreds of meters away, but that single limb was already long enough to cover a large part of the stairs.
The hook-like claw rose and then came down with its full weight.
The forces near the shrine scattered.
Lian did not move either.
[Mountain Anchor.]
The armor locked itself to the stone under his feet, and Mana moved from the soles of his feet into the stairs, spreading thin cracks in several directions.
[World-Bearing Frame.]
The structure of the Bastion became stronger.
And inside the armor, he also activated his own skill.
[Molten Bastion Body.]
A wave of heat passed through his bones, the natural defense of his body became harder, and a compressed bone structure formed.
And on the outer layer, molten heat flowed under the armor plates.
The Leviathan’s claw came down.
KAAAAAAAAAAAAABOOOOOOOOM!
The stairs under Lian exploded and pieces of stone flew dozens of meters into the air.
Kain protected himself from the shockwave behind his defensive skill, Prismatic Aegis, but even he was pushed several meters backward.
One of the Sixth Region soldiers who had not moved far enough was thrown against the wall like a piece of cloth.
For several seconds, only dust could be seen, and then a shadow moved inside it.
Lian was still standing, both of his feet had sunk almost half a meter into the stone pavement, and his knees were bent.
The armor plate on his left shoulder was cracked, and one of the silver lines had gone dark.
But both of his hands were under the huge claw of the Leviathan.
He was holding it.
Not lifting the full weight of the creature.

The Mountain Anchor was spreading most of the force into the ground, but the fact that his body had not been crushed under that attack was enough to make the people around them look at him differently.
"I guess I got my answer." Kain let out a sigh of relief.
"If you have time to talk, attack." Lian answered from under the pressure.
"With pleasure."
Light was compressed between Kain’s hands.
[Dawn Spear.]
A thin and concentrated spear came out of his palm, instead of exploding on the skin, it pierced into the joint of the Leviathan’s claw.
The creature pulled its limb back, and at that exact moment, the World-Devourer Bastion shook.
[Giant’s Momentum.]
Part of the force that the armor had endured had been stored inside its structure.
Lian released the Mountain Anchor and moved his entire body together with the armor toward the monster’s limb.
[Iron Fortress Charge.]
BOOOOOOM!
The huge joint of the Leviathan was pushed aside, and instead of returning onto the stairs, its limb crashed into the building on the left.
The three-story building collapsed instantly.
The monster roared in anger, it was clearly surprised.
It had seen these humans as nothing more than ants, ants that it could crush whenever it wanted... but it had realized that it was wrong.
Now it was truly paying attention to them and had understood, they were not ants it could ignore.

chapters.title: Chapter 519: Leviathan Of Eclipse III
paragraphs: Kain jumped down from the stairs.
[Lightbreak Step.]
His body accelerated along a golden line.
A clear image remained at his previous position for a moment, and he appeared thirty meters below.
Two strands of light came out from both of his hands.
[Dawn Chains.]
The chains wrapped around the same wounded limb of the Leviathan.
They were not supposed to stop a sixty-meter monster, but when the creature tried to pull its limb up, its movement was slightly changed for one second.
That was enough, and Lian moved.
[Ashen Thunder Step.]
Thunder ran across the broken stairs, and the twelve white eyes on the monster’s head turned almost at the same time.
Six of them turned toward Lian, three toward Kain, and the rest toward the native forces, trying to watch all of its prey at the same time.
Predator’s Instincts warned him again at the same moment, and a strand of corrupted light shot out from one of the holes.
The young Vorhelm turned his body into ash, and the beam passed through the empty space, but the second hole had followed his exit point.
He was forced to change the angle of his return, and the second beam passed beside his face.
His vision turned white for a moment, and he could even feel the heat through the armor.
"So all of them are independent."
The Twelve Corrupted Eyes were not just decorations, each one was following a different target.
Speed alone was not enough to stay away from them, he had to find a way to remain hidden from them, and the best way was to hide.
Lian activated Abyss Veil, and his presence sank into a layer of darkness.

At that moment, all six eyes of the monster that were focused on him lost track of him, however, the Leviathan did not stop chasing him and a beam came out of each of its eyes and went in different directions.
Lian used the broken wall of a building and turned behind it.
But a beam pierced through the wall, however, it did not hit him and passed beside him, and that one second was enough to give him a chance to reach the monster’s body.
The young Vorhelm landed at high speed on the creature’s side, the black plates on its body were each larger than himself.
[Glacial Reaper Claw.]
Ice formed on his right arm, and the huge claw went into the gap between two plates.
Lian pulled.
KRRRRRRRK!
The armor plate lifted, but white-black liquid immediately flowed into the gap under it and caused the plate to be pulled back down.
It had been able to heal itself in that moment.
"Faster than I thought." he whispered in surprise, without a doubt it had one of the best self-healing abilities he knew, although it was still much weaker than the Unborn Saint.
The Leviathan moved its body, and the surface under Lian’s feet rose like an earthquake.
He activated Mountain Anchor on that same plate for a moment, and the armored boots locked onto the surface.
If he had not done this, the creature’s body movement alone would have thrown him hundreds of meters into the city.
Kain created a glowing mark on the opened part from below.
[Sun Mark.]

This skill helped him mark any point he wanted with the effect of light, this way, it did not matter at what angle or distance he was from that target, he could even attack it blindly and still hit exactly that point.
The golden circle landed on the same gap.
"Keep that open!"
"I’m trying."
The second Dawn Spear hit the mark, this time the light was more precise and concentrated, and the plate cracked.
But the corrupted liquid moved toward it again, and self-healing took place.
Lian activated True Sequence, he had to find this thing’s weakness, otherwise their attacks were only wasting time.
And finally, he saw something, the source of this self-healing, but there was a problem, there was not one source, it had six different sources!
Six dense white-black masses were located in different parts of the Leviathan’s body.
One was near the left shoulder, two were along the sides, one was near the spine, one was lower down in the abdomen, and the last one was directly in front of the monster’s cores.
They were sending energy to the damaged parts of the monster’s body and healing them.
It was like a complete healing mechanism, and there was another problem, it did not seem to have any damn weakness.
"Don’t attack its natural body armor!" Lian jumped down from the creature’s body.
"You’re saying that now?" Kain paused in the middle of his next shot.
"It has a very powerful self-healing mechanism, simple attacks won’t make any difference."
The Leviathan opened its mouth again.
"Spread out!" the Third Region priest shouted.
Corrupted light gathered.
This time Kain moved forward, and a Prismatic Aegis formed in front of him, but it was not a flat shield, instead, it had several angled layers.
A white-black flood was fired.
He tilted the shield, and the impact pushed his entire body backward.
KRRRRRRRK!
Part of the beam was redirected and hit the empty wall of a tower, but not all of it, and the first layer of the shield turned black, then the second.
Kain clenched his teeth.
Lian passed beside him.
[Cataclysm Pulse.]
A shockwave was released from his body.

The corrupted beam was pushed away from its direct path for a fraction of a second, this small amount of change saved the lives of more than ten people, but those standing on the other side of the battlefield did not have the same chance.
The light fell on a group of Sixth Region forces and four of them disappeared at that moment, while three others fell to the ground with burned bodies.

Their commander shouted, but his voice was lost under the roar of the Leviathan, their forces were quickly decreasing and if this battle continued, no one except perhaps Lian, Kain, and the two Colony members would survive.
It was time to bring them out.
Lian opened the link and two presences answered.
First, One.
The huge body of the ant formed between the particles of light, and its six legs landed on the cracked street.
Then the second presence, the space beside him shook and a fifteen-meter wolf with eight eyes and a huge bone crown appeared.
Two.
Even in the middle of the chaos, several Sixth Region soldiers instinctively stepped backward, the Third Region soldiers had already seen both monsters before, so they were more prepared.
"I still get angry at its name every time I see it." Kain gave Two a short look.
"Then look at it less." the young Vorhelm jumped down from the roof.
"The problem is that it’s fifteen meters tall! Even if I want to, I can’t not see it!"
Two growled.
The Leviathan turned its head toward it, and for a moment, the two huge monsters looked at each other.
A Level 40 Fallen monster, facing a Level 50 Fallen that had swallowed corrupted light for years.
Two showed no fear, and all eight of its eyes turned red at the same time.
[Blood Hunt Moon.]
The red color in its pupils became deeper, and its body lowered, then it shot toward the Leviathan with a speed that did not match its size.
Lian had already chosen the first target, the reservoir near the left shoulder.
Two understood the target, and its claws sank into the street.
[Bone Mountain.]
The ground under one of the Leviathan’s limbs split open, and thick bone pillars came out from the stone pavement.
One.
Five.
Ten.
They wrapped around the monster’s joint and pinned its limb to the ground.
The monster immediately struggled, and the bones cracked, but they had not broken yet.
"Now!" Lian shouted at the same moment.
Kain raised his hand.
[Dawn Spear.]
A concentrated beam landed on the Sun Mark he had placed earlier.
TAK!
The armor was pierced, and at the same moment, the young Vorhelm passed beside it and drove the Glacial Reaper Claw into the hole.
Ice spread from inside the gap, and then he pulled his hand out, tearing away the armor plate along with several other pieces.
For the first time, the white-black mass under the armor was visible, this was the same reservoir and the source of the monster’s self-healing power.
The Leviathan roared, and energy from the other reservoirs immediately moved toward it to repair it.
Lian also used the Eclipse Core, and a small amount of black energy gathered in his palm.
[Suppressing Palm.]
His palm landed on the reservoir, there was almost no sound, only, THUMP!
Through that strike, a black trace of Eclipse energy entered the structure, the corrupted light around the point of contact shook...then went out.
The Eclipse energy ate through the energy paths inside the reservoir.
BOOOOOOM!
It did not take long for the mass to explode from the inside, and white-black liquid splashed around like blood, then several nearby plates collapsed.
They had finally managed to destroy one of the six reservoirs.
The Leviathan broke Bone Mountain at the same moment.
Two jumped backward.
A large part of the bones shattered, but the first target had been destroyed.
The Sixth Region saw the opportunity, and their commander raised his hand with blood covering his face.
"Right side!"
Their five remaining warriors attacked, three heavy spears made from darkness hit the Leviathan’s side.
Two explosions happened behind them, and the armor cracked, and luckily, they had managed to hit the exact location of the second reservoir.
"Hit three meters lower!!" Lian saw the second reservoir.
The man had no idea who he was, but in this battle, they had to rely on each other to survive, so he ordered them to change direction.
All the attacks landed on one point, exactly where Lian had said.
The armor opened and the second reservoir was revealed.
But the Leviathan had learned too, it was not a stupid monster, on the contrary, as a monster that had gone through two evolutions, it had considerable intelligence.
The twelve holes on its head turned, and four of them locked onto that group.
"Fall back!" the young Vorhelm sensed the warning.
But it was too late...
Four thin beams of corrupted light were fired at the same time, one of the warriors was cut in half at the waist, and the second was burned before the beam could fully hit him.
The other two took cover behind a rock, but the beam pierced through the rock.
The commander was the only one who threw himself behind a metal shield and was dragged several meters across the ground.
Almost no one remained from that group, the price of attacking the second reservoir was the lives of almost all of them.
But the gap had been opened, and Lian did not waste the chance, at the very least, he could not let their sacrifice become meaningless.
[Ashen Thunder Step.]

He appeared on the side of the Leviathan and used the Eclipse Core energy again without wasting time, but not to completely destroy the reservoir, instead, to cut the healing path coming from the other reservoirs toward the second reservoir.
After making sure the healing paths were cut, he focused directly on the second reservoir itself.
[Iron Fortress Charge.]
His armored shoulder struck the inner structure.
BOOM!
The second reservoir was torn from its place, and Two caught it with its jaws from below and ...pulled.
KRRRRRRRK!
The white-black mass came out of the monster’s body, and Two closed its jaws, crushing the reservoir.
The second reservoir was destroyed as well.
If they continued at this speed, it would not take long before they could destroy all four remaining reservoirs and finally target the monster’s vital points.

And finally, he saw something, the source of this self-healing, but there was a problem, there was not one source, it had six different sources!
Six dense white-black masses were located in different parts of the Leviathan’s body.
One was near the left shoulder, two were along the sides, one was near the spine, one was lower down in the abdomen, and the last one was directly in front of the monster’s cores.
They were sending energy to the damaged parts of the monster’s body and healing them.
It was like a complete healing mechanism, and there was another problem, it did not seem to have any damn weakness.
"Don’t attack its natural body armor!" Lian jumped down from the creature’s body.
"You’re saying that now?" Kain paused in the middle of his next shot.
"It has a very powerful self-healing mechanism, simple attacks won’t make any difference."
The Leviathan opened its mouth again.
"Spread out!" the Third Region priest shouted.
Corrupted light gathered.
This time Kain moved forward, and a Prismatic Aegis formed in front of him, but it was not a flat shield, instead, it had several angled layers.
A white-black flood was fired.
He tilted the shield, and the impact pushed his entire body backward.
KRRRRRRRK!
Part of the beam was redirected and hit the empty wall of a tower, but not all of it, and the first layer of the shield turned black, then the second.
Kain clenched his teeth.
Lian passed beside him.
[Cataclysm Pulse.]
A shockwave was released from his body.

The corrupted beam was pushed away from its direct path for a fraction of a second, this small amount of change saved the lives of more than ten people, but those standing on the other side of the battlefield did not have the same chance.
The light fell on a group of Sixth Region forces and four of them disappeared at that moment, while three others fell to the ground with burned bodies.

Their commander shouted, but his voice was lost under the roar of the Leviathan, their forces were quickly decreasing and if this battle continued, no one except perhaps Lian, Kain, and the two Colony members would survive.
It was time to bring them out.
Lian opened the link and two presences answered.
First, One.
The huge body of the ant formed between the particles of light, and its six legs landed on the cracked street.
Then the second presence, the space beside him shook and a fifteen-meter wolf with eight eyes and a huge bone crown appeared.
Two.
Even in the middle of the chaos, several Sixth Region soldiers instinctively stepped backward, the Third Region soldiers had already seen both monsters before, so they were more prepared.
"I still get angry at its name every time I see it." Kain gave Two a short look.
"Then look at it less." the young Vorhelm jumped down from the roof.
"The problem is that it’s fifteen meters tall!
Even if I want to, I can’t not see it!"
Two growled.
The Leviathan turned its head toward it, and for a moment, the two huge monsters looked at each other.
A Level 40 Fallen monster, facing a Level 50 Fallen that had swallowed corrupted light for years.
Two showed no fear, and all eight of its eyes turned red at the same time.
[Blood Hunt Moon.]
The red color in its pupils became deeper, and its body lowered, then it shot toward the Leviathan with a speed that did not match its size.
Lian had already chosen the first target, the reservoir near the left shoulder.
Two understood the target, and its claws sank into the street.
[Bone Mountain.]
The ground under one of the Leviathan’s limbs split open, and thick bone pillars came out from the stone pavement.
One.
Five.
Ten.
They wrapped around the monster’s joint and pinned its limb to the ground.
The monster immediately struggled, and the bones cracked, but they had not broken yet.
"Now!" Lian shouted at the same moment.
Kain raised his hand.
[Dawn Spear.]
A concentrated beam landed on the Sun Mark he had placed earlier.
TAK!
The armor was pierced, and at the same moment, the young Vorhelm passed beside it and drove the Glacial Reaper Claw into the hole.
Ice spread from inside the gap, and then he pulled his hand out, tearing away the armor plate along with several other pieces.
For the first time, the white-black mass under the armor was visible, this was the same reservoir and the source of the monster’s self-healing power.
The Leviathan roared, and energy from the other reservoirs immediately moved toward it to repair it.
Lian also used the Eclipse Core, and a small amount of black energy gathered in his palm.
[Suppressing Palm.]
His palm landed on the reservoir, there was almost no sound, only, THUMP!
Through that strike, a black trace of Eclipse energy entered the structure, the corrupted light around the point of contact shook...then went out.
The Eclipse energy ate through the energy paths inside the reservoir.
BOOOOOOM!
It did not take long for the mass to explode from the inside, and white-black liquid splashed around like blood, then several nearby plates collapsed.
They had finally managed to destroy one of the six reservoirs.
The Leviathan broke Bone Mountain at the same moment.
Two jumped backward.
A large part of the bones shattered, but the first target had been destroyed.
The Sixth Region saw the opportunity, and their commander raised his hand with blood covering his face.
"Right side!"
Their five remaining warriors attacked, three heavy spears made from darkness hit the Leviathan’s side.
Two explosions happened behind them, and the armor cracked, and luckily, they had managed to hit the exact location of the second reservoir.
"Hit three meters lower!!" Lian saw the second reservoir.
The man had no idea who he was, but in this battle, they had to rely on each other to survive, so he ordered them to change direction.
All the attacks landed on one point, exactly where Lian had said.
The armor opened and the second reservoir was revealed.
But the Leviathan had learned too, it was not a stupid monster, on the contrary, as a monster that had gone through two evolutions, it had considerable intelligence.
The twelve holes on its head turned, and four of them locked onto that group.
"Fall back!" the young Vorhelm sensed the warning.
But it was too late...
Four thin beams of corrupted light were fired at the same time, one of the warriors was cut in half at the waist, and the second was burned before the beam could fully hit him.
The other two took cover behind a rock, but the beam pierced through the rock.
The commander was the only one who threw himself behind a metal shield and was dragged several meters across the ground.
Almost no one remained from that group, the price of attacking the second reservoir was the lives of almost all of them.
But the gap had been opened, and Lian did not waste the chance, at the very least, he could not let their sacrifice become meaningless.
[Ashen Thunder Step.]

He appeared on the side of the Leviathan and used the Eclipse Core energy again without wasting time, but not to completely destroy the reservoir, instead, to cut the healing path coming from the other reservoirs toward the second reservoir.
After making sure the healing paths were cut, he focused directly on the second reservoir itself.
[Iron Fortress Charge.]
His armored shoulder struck the inner structure.
BOOM!
The second reservoir was torn from its place, and Two caught it with its jaws from below and ...pulled.
KRRRRRRRK!
The white-black mass came out of the monster’s body, and Two closed its jaws, crushing the reservoir.
The second reservoir was destroyed as well.
If they continued at this speed, it would not take long before they could destroy all four remaining reservoirs and finally target the monster’s vital points.

chapters.title: Chapter 520: Leviathan Of Eclipse IV
paragraphs: Kain saw the opportunity, jumped up, and moved toward the monster.
[Lightbreak Step.]
His light image remained on the ruins of a tower, while he appeared on the higher stone platform and pointed his hand toward the third reservoir.
[Sun Mark.]
The golden circle landed on the Leviathan’s armor.
At that moment, he raised both hands, light gathered high above the city, and dozens of strands reached one point.
[Noonday Judgment.]
A pillar of light descended.
BOOOOOOOOOOOM!
The black armor cracked, and the monster roared and raised its head, one of the twelve eyes turned toward Kain.
But Two moved forward and did not give the monster a chance to counterattack.
[Skyless Howl.]
The wolf’s roar spread through the city like a physical wave, and the air around the Leviathan’s head twisted.
The twelve white holes began to shake for several seconds, and the beam that was supposed to hit Kain was moved several meters away and destroyed the tower behind him.
Lian entered through the opened gap.
[Ashen Thunder Step.]
Thunder twisted inside the creature’s body.
[Thunder Calamity.]
Concentrated lightning was released from his hand and spread inside the monster’s body.
But this time, something strange happened, the monster’s self-healing power that was still coming from the four reservoirs collided with the thunder that had entered the Leviathan’s body.
As a result, part of the thunder’s structure began to collapse.
Lian immediately stopped the skill, if he continued, he would only waste Mana.

"Looks like it at least has a counter to it, this thing’s power is actually not just healing power, it destroys the structure of anything that tries to damage the monster’s body and at the same time, it can also rebuild the structure of the monster itself." he reasoned after seeing this scene.
The fact that it could disable the structure of attacks was somewhat similar to Eclipse energy, and the fact that it could also heal its host could be related to light.
It could be said that this was the result of combining light and Eclipse, this monster had absorbed both throughout all the years of its life and had managed to form such a structure.
The young Vorhelm sighed, such a monster had only been formed from a small part of the Eclipse Demon’s pure energy.
Since skills did not work, he put his hand inside the gap, using physical strength instead.
The third reservoir cracked under his raw power, and with absolute force, he completely destroyed all the defensive layers of the reservoir.
At the same moment, with his signal, Kain sent [Dawn Spear] into the same gap.
BOOM!
The third reservoir was destroyed in the blink of an eye as well.
The Leviathan no longer behaved like before, until that moment, it had mostly reacted to the closest threat, but now it had understood exactly what they were targeting.
White-black light came out from all the gaps in its body.
Lian immediately jumped backward, his senses started warning him that the monster was going to launch a large counterattack.
[Drowned Dead Dawn.]
A pale white-black dome spread from the monster’s body.
Ten meters.
Fifty.
One hundred.
When it reached the young Vorhelm, the Mana around his armor started to shake, and the lines of the World-Devourer Bastion began to flash one after another.
This was not a beam, the environment itself had become corrupted.
"Get out of the area!" Kain shouted.
But the Leviathan had covered the entire middle part of the city.
One, who was near one of the buildings, reacted later than the others, and a strand of corrupted light rose from the ground and hit its side.
TAK!
The ant’s natural armor cracked and it was thrown to the side with great force, the feeling of pain reached its master through the link, it was strong but not fatal.
"One!"
The ant tried to stand up, one of its back legs was shaking.
Lian decided at that moment that he would no longer allow it to fight the Leviathan directly, One was only Level 20 while this damn monster was Level 50.
Every attack from this monster could be deadly and devastating to the giant ant.
He ordered it to retreat and told it that it was not allowed to interfere in the battle.
One sent both dissatisfaction and pain at the same time, as if the first Colony member did not want to look useless in the eyes of its master.
It did not want its master to think that the big wolf was better than it, it would rather die while protecting its master than retreat.
"Why does an ant have to be this stubborn?" Lian also did not want to watch it die, and without considering its feelings, he canceled its summon.
One turned into thousands of particles of light and disappeared.
He turned his attention back to the main monster, then sent an order through the link to his second Colony member.
The eight-eyed wolf lowered its head.
[Feast of the Dead.]
Black strands came out from its mouth and claws, the remains on the ground dried up, and the old and new wounds on Two’s body closed slightly.
Then eight shadows separated from around it.
[Bodiless Pack.]
Ghost-like wolves jumped onto the Leviathan’s body from several directions.
None of them had enough power to break the armor, but breaking it was not their goal, their goal was to divide the attention of the twelve eyes and buy time so Lian and Kain could finish the job.
The Leviathan fired three beams and two ghosts disappeared immediately.
At the same moment, Two moved, its master had marked the location of the fourth reservoir on the monster’s back, if its ghosts were not enough, it would also help open the path.
But reaching it was difficult, the Leviathan could see almost all direct paths.
[Pathless World.]
For several seconds, directions became wrong.
The Leviathan turned its head to the left, while Lian was coming from the right.
Two other eyes looked upward, but Kain was below.
It was as if the creature’s sense of direction had become trapped inside a broken map.
Even though it was a Level 50 Fallen monster, it had never been trapped in such a situation before, and even it completely lost its sense of direction and space for several minutes.
And this was the best opportunity that Two could create for its master.
[Ashen Thunder Step.]
Lian moved from one wall to the next roof and then landed on the Leviathan’s body.
[Glacial Reaper Claw.]
With the strike of the ice claw, three plates on the monster’s body moved aside.
[Grave Fang.]
A jaw made of Mana immediately closed around part of the internal tissue and held it in place for a moment.
This helped prevent the monster’s body plates, which acted like natural armor, from immediately healing and returning to their original positions.
It could buy them a little time.
The young Vorhelm pushed his palm into the gap, just like before, it was time to use raw power to disable the defensive layers of the reservoir.
TAK!
The fourth reservoir cracked.
But it was not enough to finish the reservoir, and Kain was also directly fighting the monster and could not come to help.
Feeling Two’s position, it jumped up from below at that moment, and its real jaws closed around the same area.
KRRRACK!
The fourth reservoir was destroyed as well.
Pathless World ended, and Two landed on the ground, its legs shaking for a moment.
Using that disaster was not cheap.
But five more disasters were still awake inside its body, and the Leviathan was still alive.
The creature became enraged, turned its body to the left, and its huge tail passed through the city.
Dozens of buildings were completely cut in half, three Third Region soldiers had no chance to escape, and the wall, bodies, and pieces of stone were thrown into the air together.
The priest who had created a defensive array could only protect himself and the two people beside him.
The others disappeared under the rubble...
The Sixth Region was no better, the four people who were still beside their commander tried to escape down the street.

One of the Leviathan’s limbs landed on the ground, two of them were crushed immediately and the third was thrown into a wall...only the commander and three warriors remained alive in different places.
The battle between the two Regions was practically over, not because anyone had won, but because almost no one remained.
Only God knew how the two Regions would react when all the battalions they had sent never returned.

chapters.title: Chapter 521: Leviathan Of Eclipse V
paragraphs: Meanwhile, Lian looked at the fifth reservoir, it was in the lower part of the Leviathan’s side and well protected, and the creature was now more alert than before and was blocking the paths.
"Do you have any plan now?" Kain looked at him from a distance, he was breathing heavily and it was clear that he was not at his best anymore.
His amount of Mana and Resistance compared to Lian’s stats was like a joke, against such a monster and the amount of power he was forced to use, getting tired was natural.
It was unlikely that he could endure much longer, and he was slowly reaching his limit.
But at the same time, he was trying not to show any weakness, he did not want to become an extra burden in the eyes of his best friend who needed to be protected.
"Maybe I have a way." Lian did not explain much either and raised his hand, the air around them suddenly became cold.
[Frost Dominion.]
This time, it did not spread across the whole city, he focused all of its power on half of the Leviathan’s body.

Ice rose from the black surface under the creature’s feet, first the lower limb, then the joint, then the side, and within a few seconds, a large part of the right side of the Leviathan was trapped inside a huge mass of blue-white ice.
The creature roared, its muscles tightened, and the ice began to crack.
"Good ...break it." Lian had been waiting for this.
The Leviathan turned its body with all its strength.
KRRRRRRRRRK!
The mass of ice exploded, but along with it, several plates from the monster’s body were also torn away, some of the same plates that were protecting the reservoir.
"Great! Leave the rest to me." Kain saw the opportunity.
[Dawnfall.]
Dozens of thin beams of light that looked like arrows, with burning and destructive tips, fell from above onto the opened section.
The goal was not to destroy it, the goal was to prevent the gap from closing.
The many lights forced the healing path to divide between several points.
Lian’s eyes lit up, and he immediately used the opportunity and entered.
[Thunder Calamity.]
The lightning went directly inside the reservoir, the creature tried to eat it with corrupted light like before, the same light that was formed from the combination of Eclipse and pure light.
The same power that had managed to disable this move before.
But the young Vorhelm cut the flow before the skill collapsed, and a huge and destructive ice claw formed on his hand, and he slammed it into the fifth reservoir with all his strength.
BOOOM!
The force was enough to crack the reservoir, and Kain also sent the final attack from a distance like before.
[Dawn Spear.]
TAK!
The fifth reservoir broke as well ...and at the same time, Lian and Kain both retreated.
"Damn ...you did great! You’re really a monster yourself." Kain laughed loudly and still could not believe that they had managed to go this far against such a monster.
His greatest achievement had always been defeating a Level 20 Fallen, and even that had been done with traps and a lot of planning.
But now? With the help of his best friend, he was slaughtering a Level 50 Fallen!
"Your work isn’t bad either, you’re more skilled at teamwork than you think." Lian said calmly.
"You know, Lian, I think we make a great team, no joke, this has been the best battle of my life so far."
"We haven’t even won yet." the young Vorhelm laughed.
"Yeah, but I’m sure we’ll win, just look, the monster is almost dead."

The Child Of Light was right, only one reservoir remained, of course, destroying the reservoirs did not mean the complete death of the monster, but it would definitely disable its self-healing mechanism completely, and then they could finish it off.
With the help of True Sequence, Lian looked at the last one, the sixth reservoir was larger than the others.

The Leviathan had also realized how bad its situation was, it had lost a large part of its recovery power, and to protect the only remaining reservoir, all the corrupted light in its body moved toward the front part of its chest.
The black plates on that area became thicker, and at least three defensive layers were created there.
"I think it knows that this is its last one too." Kain looked at it from a distance of one hundred meters.
"Yeah."
"Please tell me you have a plan for this too?"
"Do you doubt me? I always have a plan." Lian smiled and sent a direct order to his second Colony member.
Two raised its head, its eight red eyes were still under the effect of Blood Hunt Moon.
The Leviathan opened its mouth, corrupted light was gathering, and it looked like it was preparing to launch a large attack.
And the eight-eyed wolf moved forward as well.
[Reversed Maw.]
The space in front of its mouth twisted, and when the flood of corrupted light was released, part of the attack entered the reversed space directly.
The wolf lowered its body, and its bones made sounds from the damage.
The power of the light beam was too great, and part of the beam passed to the side and landed on the wolf’s shoulder, causing its skin and bone armor to burn completely.
Two roared in pain.
But the main path of the attack was redirected, and the result was a successful defense.
"Thanks, Wolf Of Doomsday, you did great." Kain moved.
[Dawn Chains.] wrapped around the Leviathan’s neck.
[Inverted Day.]
The light around Two changed, and the white light of Blighted Radiance became darker for a moment, the black parts inside it changed direction.
The power of the attack decreased.
Lian moved, now it was his turn ...but the Leviathan was waiting for him too.
All twelve eyes turned toward him at the same time, and the beams came from twelve angles.
Feeling the attack, he immediately activated [Ashen Thunder Step].
He passed two beams, and the third blocked his exit point, then his body turned into ash and the fourth followed the path of the ash.
Feeling that he could not save himself from these beams just by running away, he directly counterattacked.
[Cataclysm Pulse.]
The shockwave redirected three beams, but unfortunately, he was not completely lucky, and the fourth hit the armor’s shoulder.
TAK!
The plate of the World-Devourer Bastion turned black, and the line underneath it went out.
[World-Devourer Bastion Integrity has decreased.]
[Structural Memory activated.]
The metal began to repair itself, but the corrupted light was still on it and the repair was eaten away again, the Leviathan’s special ability could even disable the armor’s recovery structure.
Lian immediately locked World-Bearing Frame onto that area, and the internal paths of the armor separated from the infected shoulder.
The corruption did not spread, this was the first time that instead of enduring an attack, he had been forced to use the armor to isolate the damage.
The Leviathan sensed this, and white-black strands came out from its armor.
But these were no longer beams ...they were more like living whips, and dozens of them danced in the sky like lightning.
