chapters.title: Chapter 549: Somehow A Duel With Seris ( GT Bonus - )
paragraphs: Seris did not react for two seconds, and then her eyebrows slightly came together, it was not clear what was going through her mind, but in one moment, thousands of thoughts passed through her mind.
And she did not look happy.
"My father said that?"
"Almost word for word."
"And what did you say?" Her tone became slightly shaky, so slight that even Lian did not notice it, but there was a very thin trace of worry in that tone about his answer.
"No." Lian looked at her.
Seris stayed silent.
For a few seconds, and in that silence, her eyes became a little softer than their usual cold look, as if she was relieved, and then she only said,
"Good."
And she walked past him.
He looked at her back for a few moments.
That was all, good, but it was strange that those one words meant more than a whole paragraph of an answer.
Lian moved and walked beside her.
"That’s all?"
"What did you expect?" Seris gave him a quick look.
"I don’t know, maybe I expected you to tell me I’m crazy for daring to say no to a Celestial?"
"No." She continued walking.
Lian decided not to continue the discussion, and a few minutes later, Seris herself asked,
"Do you want to see something?"
"Sure."
"My first Evolution."
This time, his attention became complete, he had been curious about this since last night, this girl was already a monster and he wanted to know how her path would progress.
"Come." She changed her path.
The training field Seris had chosen was inside the inner part of the estate. It was not as large as the public training fields, and it did not have any spectator stands.
It was a stone area about fifty meters wide, with several training walls, weapon racks, and defensive arrays around it.
When they entered, there was no one inside, and the girl walked toward the weapon rack and picked up a training sword.
"My class changed and evolved." Seris held the blade in front of herself.
"Before the Evolution, I was a Warrior, and after the Evolution, Blade of Moon."
Lian repeated the name once in his mind, Blade of Moon, it was mostly clear that it was related to the structure of her power, her skills, and her way of fighting.
But what surprised him more was that this girl was telling him about her Evolution and her class without any worry, when most people kept these things secret.
Seris completely trusted him, they had already been together twice in situations of life and death, and they had fought monsters much stronger than themselves.
And they had trusted each other many times in situations that could have ended their lives.
Of course, he was sure that the matter was not only about showing her class, this girl wanted to find out whether after her first Evolution, she had finally caught up to him or not.
Lian gave a very faint smile.
"Alright."
"The best way to see it, is to experience it." She said softly.
Seris still did not move.
Silver Mana came out of her body.
Dense strands of energy rose from her back and shoulders and came together at one point several meters above her body.
Silver light spread out and formed a crescent, quickly becoming larger.
A crescent almost four meters wide formed behind her and covered the training field in cold light.
It had a special feeling, and it was like the light of the night.
Seris’s hair moved gently in the Mana around her, and the golden lines of the Ancestral Mark on the back of her right hand could be seen for a moment in the silver light.
Lian’s gaze became focused.
The Mana was not only working on her body, part of it was intentionally being kept outside.
The crescent behind Seris was not a decoration, it was part of the structure of her class.
Seris raised the sword and then moved, and the eight-meter distance was almost cut in half in the blink of an eye.
She did not attack directly, her left foot moved slightly outward and her body changed its angle, at the same moment, the sword came up from the lower right side.
Lian read the path and raised his hand to block the attack.
But only a few centimeters before the impact, something changed.
Her wrist turned, her elbow opened slightly, and the blade that was supposed to hit his hand directly changed its path almost in the middle of the same attack.
Lian moved his body backward.
Whoosh!
The edge of the sword passed less than a few centimeters from his side.
Good.
Very good.
An ordinary Warrior, when putting all their strength into an attack, could no longer make such a change, not without sacrificing speed and power.
But Seris had almost lost nothing.
Lian was still thinking about this change when silver light separated from the path of the sword.
A thin crescent almost two meters long came straight toward his face.
He moved his head to the side, his natural speed was very high, and dodging it was easy for him, and the crescent passed beside his cheek.
Behind him...Tick!
The sound was not very loud.
One of the stone barriers of the field looked completely fine for a moment.
Then a thin line opened across its center.
The upper part of the stone slowly slid over the lower part and fell to the ground with a heavy sound.
The cut was almost perfectly straight.
Lian looked at Seris again, she was no longer in her previous position.
Footsteps came from the left, and the silver sword came down toward his neck, but he raised both hands again to block the attack.
Clang!
The clash was short, but the girl did not push, and immediately broke the contact, her blade went down and returned from the other side with a short turn.
He blocked this one too.
The third attack came immediately after it, and then the fourth came right behind it.
But something became clear to Lian very quickly, Seris was not attacking randomly, every move was creating the next move.
One attack forced him to raise his hands, the next attack aimed exactly at the space below his defense.
If he turned his body, she used the direction of his movement to create the angle for her next attack.
’Clearly, the structure of her body has changed too.’ This was the conclusion he reached, his body had become stronger and much more powerful after his Evolution.
But it seemed that Seris’s body had changed as well, it had become extremely flexible, and she could use her body in any way she wanted at any moment.
Her body no longer had any reflex limitations, to some extent, her body was almost like plastic.
At that moment, the fifth attack came, Lian retreated without thinking, but the next moment, the girl changed its direction in an instant and the sword was placed against his chest.
Finished.
Or at least, it was supposed to be finished, that was what Seris expected at least, and for a moment, she thought she had really managed to defeat him.
But she was about to be disappointed...

chapters.title: Chapter 550: Moon Manifestation
paragraphs: Lian moved one step to the left without thinking, his natural speed was so fast that it was unlikely this girl could follow him with her eyes.
Whoosh!
But suddenly, something passed through the space where his neck had been a moment ago.
He turned his gaze back for a fraction of a second, a semi-transparent silver blade had passed beside his head for a moment.
But from what he could see, the girl had not even had time to move her sword from where it was, so where had this attack suddenly come from?
Lian looked at Seris again, the only change was that the crescent behind her had become slightly larger.
And he understood what had happened, some of her attacks could leave an echo behind and activate at exactly the moment he dodged the main attack.
Was this related to her class itself, or was it just a skill?
"This one was better."
"I haven’t even started yet."
Then the sword moved three times, and three silver crescents separated from the blade.
The first went straight, the second went higher, and the third went to the right.
Lian saw their movements.
He caught the first one with his hand easily and threw it away.
Clang!
The second crescent came down from above, he moved half a step to the side and its edge passed beside his shoulder and created a deep cut on the stone floor.
The third was passing beside him, but suddenly bent in the middle of its path.
Young Vorhelm’s eyes narrowed, the crescent turned back at an unnatural angle and attacked his side.
He made his hand into a fist and faced the attack directly, and as a result, the crescent broke.
"Hm?" But before he could lower his guard, a sound came from behind him.
The first crescent, the one Lian had thought he had knocked away with the attack, had turned in the air and come back again.
His left forearm was covered by a thick layer of ice, and the crescent hit it.
Crack!
The ice on his forearm cracked, but the silver blade was knocked away and hit the ground, silver particles spreading through the air.
He looked at them.
To his complete surprise, the particles did not disappear, they returned toward Seris, or more precisely, toward the crescent behind her, and the crescent grew a little more.
Lian slowly breathed out, now the picture was clearer.
Seris’s class had not only made her sword stronger, it could create a field, and every attack could produce a separate blade.
The blades were not completely out of control after being released.
She could change their paths.
Some attacks could also repeat later as echoes, and even when a blade was destroyed, part of its Mana returned to that moon.
The longer the battle continued, the more complete the crescent became.
Lian kept his eyes on the silver shape behind Seris, what would happen if that moon became complete? If his guess was correct, that thing was an Innate Skill related to her class.
He could feel that as the battle continued and the crescent became stronger, she was becoming stronger and stronger.
He doubted that any person her age except himself could defeat this girl, and her first Evolution had made her even more dangerous.
Seris did not give him time to think more, and the next attack had already started.
This time, Lian did not only defend.
He saw her first step, the attack came from above and toward him, he raised his right hand, but before they could collide, this time she broke her own angle.
His fist passed under Seris’s sword and came toward her shoulder, his speed was so fast that his opponent had no chance to react.
His fist hit her shoulder and completely broke the girl’s balance, but with the help of her body structure, which had a very high ability to adapt, she managed to move herself to the side.
But Lian did not care and moved forward,
Seris noticed it at that moment, and a crescent separated from behind her and came down between the two of them to create distance between them.
That crescent turned into two silver blades and targeted him from both sides.
Young Vorhelm broke one and easily passed through the second, at the same moment, the echo of one of the previous attacks activated from behind.
He lowered his body, and the sound of the air being cut passed over his head.
Seris entered from the front at exactly that moment and attacked with her own sword.
Now Lian was being attacked from three angles, a new crescent coming toward him from the right, an echo attacking from behind, and now the girl’s own attack.
He was being attacked from three directions by one person at the same time.
Lian gave a faint smile, this was the true power of her class.
Forcing the opponent to fight against different times of an attack and angles that could even change after being released.
For someone with normal perception, it was a nightmare, the problem was that the attacks were also extremely fast, and a normal Awakened or monster could not adapt to them at all.
But Lian’s instincts and perception were among the strongest of all Awakened who had passed their first Evolution, and dealing with this situation was not difficult for him.
Lian’s fist hit Seris’s sword and at the same time, his foot hit the ground.
Ice came out from under the floor, and three short pillars rose at different angles.
The crescent on the right was forced to change its path, and the echo from behind hit one of the pillars.
She pulled her sword free and moved backward.
But he did not let her create the distance completely this time and took a step forward.
Seris released two more crescents so she could put more pressure on him.
But Lian easily passed between them, one passed beside his neck and the second passed near his knee.
For the first time, she was forced to move completely defensively, repeated fists came toward her one after another, and she could barely deflect or stop them.
She pressed her teeth together slightly, every fist put a huge amount of pressure on her, and from the grin on Lian’s face, she could guess that this was not even all of his power.
And worse, he had just used the new ability from his Evolution, but this boy? Nothing, he had still not shown or used anything from his Evolution.
She took a breath, and right there, the crescent behind her shone more brightly.
Almost half of a full moon had been completed, and at the same time, six different crescents appeared around the girl.
Lian slowed his step, and Seris raised her sword, she said nothing, and the six crescents moved at the same time.
From above.
Below.
Behind.
From both sides.
One directly.
He saw all the paths in one moment, but this time, it was not only the crescents, the girl herself came as well.
Simply put, seven attacks from seven angles were attacking him at the same time.
He punched and broke the first one, bent down and passed under the second, and the third was deflected by an ice pillar.
The fourth changed its path in the middle of its movement, and Lian had to dodge at the exact moment.
And this was what Seris wanted.
The real sword came toward his shoulder from a very close distance, he defended in time, and caught the girl’s sword with his hand.
But a silver layer on the blade lit up, and suddenly, a very special power began to spread from it and attack Lian.
Clack!
Seris pushed and tried to completely disable his hand, if she could make one of his fists unusable, she would gain a huge advantage in the battle.
But Lian only gave her sword a short look, it was time for him to show this girl a little of his own Evolution too.
Eclipse Core.
A very small amount of Eclipse energy came out of the core, and black energy moved along the fingers of his left hand.
Young Pendragon saw it, and for a moment, her eyes stopped on his hand.
One of the silver crescents attacked from the left, but instead of dodging, Lian raised his hand, and the Eclipse energy touched the surface of the crescent.
There was no explosion, and the crescent simply...collapsed.
The silver light at the point of contact turned black.
Dark cracks spread through the entire Mana structure, and in less than a moment, the blade that until then could cut through anything turned into pieces of unstable light.
Seris’s expression changed, she did not know what this was, but even seeing it gave her a bad feeling, and what she had seen was clear.
That energy had not broken her crescent with greater power, it had broken its structure apart.
So this was part of this man’s Evolution?

Whoosh!

But from what he could see, the girl had not even had time to move her sword from where it was, so where had this attack suddenly come from?
Lian looked at Seris again, the only change was that the crescent behind her had become slightly larger.
And he understood what had happened, some of her attacks could leave an echo behind and activate at exactly the moment he dodged the main attack.
Was this related to her class itself, or was it just a skill?
"This one was better."
"I haven’t even started yet."
Then the sword moved three times, and three silver crescents separated from the blade.
The first went straight, the second went higher, and the third went to the right.
Lian saw their movements.
He caught the first one with his hand easily and threw it away.
Clang!
The second crescent came down from above, he moved half a step to the side and its edge passed beside his shoulder and created a deep cut on the stone floor.
The third was passing beside him, but suddenly bent in the middle of its path.
Young Vorhelm’s eyes narrowed, the crescent turned back at an unnatural angle and attacked his side.
He made his hand into a fist and faced the attack directly, and as a result, the crescent broke.
"Hm?" But before he could lower his guard, a sound came from behind him.
The first crescent, the one Lian had thought he had knocked away with the attack, had turned in the air and come back again.
His left forearm was covered by a thick layer of ice, and the crescent hit it.
Crack!
The ice on his forearm cracked, but the silver blade was knocked away and hit the ground, silver particles spreading through the air.
He looked at them.
To his complete surprise, the particles did not disappear, they returned toward Seris, or more precisely, toward the crescent behind her, and the crescent grew a little more.
Lian slowly breathed out, now the picture was clearer.
Seris’s class had not only made her sword stronger, it could create a field, and every attack could produce a separate blade.
The blades were not completely out of control after being released.
She could change their paths.
Some attacks could also repeat later as echoes, and even when a blade was destroyed, part of its Mana returned to that moon.
The longer the battle continued, the more complete the crescent became.
Lian kept his eyes on the silver shape behind Seris, what would happen if that moon became complete?
If his guess was correct, that thing was an Innate Skill related to her class.
He could feel that as the battle continued and the crescent became stronger, she was becoming stronger and stronger.
He doubted that any person her age except himself could defeat this girl, and her first Evolution had made her even more dangerous.
Seris did not give him time to think more, and the next attack had already started.
This time, Lian did not only defend.
He saw her first step, the attack came from above and toward him, he raised his right hand, but before they could collide, this time she broke her own angle.
His fist passed under Seris’s sword and came toward her shoulder, his speed was so fast that his opponent had no chance to react.
His fist hit her shoulder and completely broke the girl’s balance, but with the help of her body structure, which had a very high ability to adapt, she managed to move herself to the side.
But Lian did not care and moved forward,
Seris noticed it at that moment, and a crescent separated from behind her and came down between the two of them to create distance between them.
That crescent turned into two silver blades and targeted him from both sides.
Young Vorhelm broke one and easily passed through the second, at the same moment, the echo of one of the previous attacks activated from behind.
He lowered his body, and the sound of the air being cut passed over his head.
Seris entered from the front at exactly that moment and attacked with her own sword.
Now Lian was being attacked from three angles, a new crescent coming toward him from the right, an echo attacking from behind, and now the girl’s own attack.
He was being attacked from three directions by one person at the same time.
Lian gave a faint smile, this was the true power of her class.
Forcing the opponent to fight against different times of an attack and angles that could even change after being released.
For someone with normal perception, it was a nightmare, the problem was that the attacks were also extremely fast, and a normal Awakened or monster could not adapt to them at all.
But Lian’s instincts and perception were among the strongest of all Awakened who had passed their first Evolution, and dealing with this situation was not difficult for him.
Lian’s fist hit Seris’s sword and at the same time, his foot hit the ground.
Ice came out from under the floor, and three short pillars rose at different angles.
The crescent on the right was forced to change its path, and the echo from behind hit one of the pillars.
She pulled her sword free and moved backward.
But he did not let her create the distance completely this time and took a step forward.
Seris released two more crescents so she could put more pressure on him.
But Lian easily passed between them, one passed beside his neck and the second passed near his knee.
For the first time, she was forced to move completely defensively, repeated fists came toward her one after another, and she could barely deflect or stop them.
She pressed her teeth together slightly, every fist put a huge amount of pressure on her, and from the grin on Lian’s face, she could guess that this was not even all of his power.
And worse, he had just used the new ability from his Evolution, but this boy?
